$schema-note: Grep catalog for the Jalat frontend security-scan. Each pattern is a JS regex (string form). Used by .claude/hooks/security-scan.py and the security-scan skill.

patterns.message: dangerouslySetInnerHTML — XSS risk. Sanitize or avoid rendering raw HTML, especially user content (comments, feedback, trip plans, agency profiles).
eval() executes arbitrary code — remove it.
new Function() is dynamic code execution — remove it.
Hardcoded secret/credential in client code. Move it to server-side env.
NEXT_PUBLIC_* is exposed to the browser — never put secrets behind it.
Non-TLS http:// endpoint to a remote host — use https://.
Inline role comparison — route authorization through lib/permissions.ts instead of re-deriving it here.
